purpose: Define Meta as the semantic ownership layer for module/domain models, schemas, relations and constraints, independent from whether those semantics are exposed through Expose.

topics.name: Meta
topics.purpose: Define Meta as the semantic ownership layer for module/domain models, schemas, relations and constraints, independent from whether those semantics are exposed through Expose.

semantics.expose_rule: Meta is not under Expose unless a MetaModule/view exposes a human-facing surface.
semantics.schema_rule: Schemas belong to their explicit Meta/semantic owner.
semantics.relation_rule: Relations are declared by explicit semantic owners and may be referenced by instances/domains.
semantics.runtime_rule: Meta definition is declarative semantics, not runtime authority.
semantics.projection_rule: Editor/Expose projections do not take ownership from Meta.

invariants.rule: Universal substrates, domain compositions, Meta ownership and relations remain explicit and non-duplicated.

hard_gates.condition: Meta ownership inferred from Expose placement
schema owned only by form/UI definition
relation created ad hoc by runtime instance without Meta declaration
Meta definition treated as runtime authority

references.purpose: Meta may own explicit schema semantics.
Exposure does not alter Meta ownership.
